name: Toybox
about: Glossy toy plastic for a light, quick game with a mascot hero: round blue plates with a pale rim on a little plinth, white rounded letters, yellow for what matters, green for what is going well. Sized for the hand. A show of stages: speed chevrons behind the title, dots behind a menu, streaks while it loads, confetti on a result, nothing over a count.
author: mojulo
